name: @pubshift/core
//exports: Subpaths so a consumer outside the web app (packages/cli) can reach an emitter without a bundler alias. apps/web keeps using its own @emit/* alias, which swaps in a stub for an emitter that is not written yet; this does not. The note lives out here because every key inside "exports" must start with ".": Node rejects the whole package config otherwise (ERR_INVALID_PACKAGE_CONFIG) and webpack refuses to resolve the package at all.
